title: Plus Code Tools
description: Encodes latitude and longitude into an Open Location Code (Plus Code) and decodes a full code to its center and bounding box. A short code is recovered when referenceLatitude and referenceLongitude are given; a full code with a reference is shortened. Returns validity, operation, code, codeLength, and coordinates. Invalid input returns valid:false with error and message.

code.description: Plus Code to decode, shorten, or recover. Case-insensitive; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, used when code is omitted.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, used when code is omitted.

codeLength.description: Significant digits to encode, 2 to 15. Even when shorter than 10. Defaults to 10.

referenceLatitude.description: Reference latitude for shortening a full code or recovering a short code.

referenceLongitude.description: Reference longitude for shortening a full code or recovering a short code.
